vscodevim.documented: VSCodeVim 1.32.4 actions/commands/replace.ts L12-L75 queues replaceText in Normal mode without entering Insert. state/recordedState.ts L146 initializes isInsertion=false; mode/modeHandler.ts L715-L716 only sets it in Insert, and L838-L840 guards the dot-register write with isInsertion. Thus normal r/r and r/X leave the prior dot register unchanged. Scoped to the two normal-r card rows without setup; counted, Visual and Replace mode are excluded.
